dict.string: Sugarman can read an owned sensor package or tag to identify the sensor. Scanning does not activate or bind the sensor.
Sugarman uses Bluetooth to connect to an owned glucose sensor you have already set up. It does not send sensor commands until hardware evidence gates pass.

Sugarman can scan a package Data Matrix to identify an owned sensor. Scanning does not send sensor commands.
Sugarman can read workouts you choose to share so you can overlay them with glucose. HealthKit glucose writes are disabled until validation gates pass.
Sugarman may later write validated glucose to Apple Health. HealthKit glucose writes are disabled in this build.
